title: Filed Percentages: Endorsement Premium Billed Ahead on the First Direct Bill Invoice by Certificate — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Q. Does the certificate an owner term backs change the first invoice after a move off automatic draft?**
A. Yes. Under the company's own filed percentages for the **Installment Payment Plans**, the first invoice after an owner plan is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan adds to its premium a percentage of the endorsement premium left to bill (every additional premium transaction booked on the Owner Auto Policy term, less the premium the plan's installment invoices have billed beyond the old schedule's installment premium for each of them):

- term written to back an FR-44 certificate (its financial responsibility filing is FR-44): 10 percent;
- term written to back an SR-22 certificate (its financial responsibility filing is SR-22): 5 percent;
- term backing no certificate: nothing.

**Q. Where is the certificate read?**
A. From the Owner Auto Policy term's own record of the financial responsibility filing it is written to back.

**Q. Hypothetically, 300.00 is left to bill on an SR-22 term. What is added?**
A. 5 percent of 300.00, which is 15.00.
